programs.desc: This hidden-camera series follows three lifelong friends -- Brian "Q" Quinn, James "Murr" Murray and Sal Vulcano -- who take dares to an outrageous level. On the show, to find out who is best under pressure, the guys compete in awkward and hilarious hidden-camera hijinks, and are awarded points for their successes. With the help of a celebrity guest, the episode's loser must endure an embarrassing punishment of epic proportions.
